name: Beached Sea Turtle
summary: Along Darkshore, a Beached Sea Turtle lies among the surf as murlocs scavenge its remains. Auberdine naturalists seek sound samples to send to Darnassus for study.

sections.title: A Stranded Leviathan
sections.body: Dead sea turtles drift ashore along Darkshore’s coast, or beach themselves in confusion. Their remains soon draw scavengers. Greymist murlocs have made crude camps around this turtle’s skeletal frame and carve away its flesh and shell. Yet bone, shell, or tissue may remain intact in the wreckage.

sections.title: Field Research for Darnassus
sections.body: Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde works in Auberdine as a field researcher, recording unusual marine life and disturbances along the coast. Night elves regard stranded beasts with reverence and scientific curiosity. Suitable remains are cataloged and prepared for shipment to scholars in Darnassus. They seek to learn why so many giants of the open sea wash ashore.

faq.q: Why are there so many beached sea creatures in Darkshore?
faq.answer: Strong coastal currents and turbulent waters drive debris and dying sea beasts onto Darkshore’s sand. Night elf scholars suspect disturbances in the deep ocean are drawing marine life toward the shallows, so local naturalists study each corpse that washes ashore.

faq.q: Who wants the sea turtle remains?
aliases: who do i turn this in to
where to turn in turtle remains
faq.answer: Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde, a night elf researcher in Auberdine, gathers washed-up samples for naturalists and scholars in Darnassus.

faq.q: Why are murlocs gathered around the turtle?
faq.answer: Greymist murlocs scavenge what washes onto the beaches. A giant turtle offers abundant meat, tough hide, and bone for tools and shelters.

faq.q: What happens to the samples once Gwennyth receives them?
aliases: what does darnassus do with remains
faq.answer: Gwennyth packages viable tissue and skeletal samples for transport across the sea to Darnassus. Scholars and priestesses examine them to monitor the coastal ecosystem’s health and behavior.

faq.q: Is this the only beached creature along the coast?
faq.answer: No. Darkshore’s long coast holds multiple beached sea turtles and stranded sea behemoths. Several yield research specimens for Auberdine’s scholars.

faq.q: Are sea turtles sacred to the night elves?
faq.answer: Night elves revere Kalimdor’s native beasts as part of the natural balance under Elune and the wild gods. Sea turtles are not solitary divine avatars, but their unexpected deaths and beachings warn of grave ecological trouble.

angles.text: As a night elf, you know unexplained beachings of ancient sea creatures signal deeper disruption in Kalimdor’s waters. Researchers in Auberdine and Darnassus investigate each washed-up leviathan.
As a druid, you see stranded sea life and scavenging murlocs as signs of ecological imbalance along Darkshore. That calls for close observation and healing.
